correctness.rationale: For odd m>=3, f_m is the restriction of the homogeneous harmonic polynomial Re((x+i y)^m), hence Delta_S2 f_m=-m(m+1)f_m and f_m is antipodally odd. Direct differentiation gives A=(m-1)sin^(m-2)(theta) B. The matrix B+(m+1)I has nonnegative diagonal entries and determinant whose minimum over x=cos(m phi) occurs at x=1 and equals (1-t)(2m+1-(m+1)t)>=0. The longitude shift gives the matching upper spectral bound. Equatorial eigenvalues establish the necessary sharp threshold and exact zero-radius normals. The support-volume expansion, parity cancellation, integrated Bochner identity and exact beta integral establish the volume formula.

value.rationale: The sectoral mode is a canonical m-fold rotationally symmetric odd harmonic, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its exact maximal convex amplitude, complete endpoint degeneracy locus, and endpoint volume are useful reproducible benchmarks for finite-mode studies of the classical three-dimensional constant-width volume problem. The result carefully avoids any unsupported global minimizer claim.
